title: Error Spectrum Lens and Tracehook Consolidation
creator: Priya Natarajan
description: Deliver an integrated error dashboard (the 'Error Spectrum Lens') and consolidate tracehook behavior so triage teams can quickly attribute failures to timeouts, overload/backpressure, model errors (rejects/invalid outputs), and transport-level codes (HTTP/gRPC). This ticket covers taxonomy definition, metrics/log pipeline changes, tracehook enrichment spec, dashboard panels, and alert-to-SLO mapping. Goal: reduce mean time to root cause for API errors by 40% for P1 incidents and make automated fallback decisions (model variant vs retry) easier to reason about.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical failure taxonomy published in Confluence covering at least: timeout, overload (queue/backpressure), model rejection/error, application error, transport code mappings (4xx/5xx and gRPC equivalents)
Tracehook enrichment implemented so spans include failure_reason and model_variant when applicable (prefix caching, kv-miss, kernel OOM noted)
Metric/log pipeline populated with normalized tags (failure_reason, request_tier, model_id, model_variant, sequence_length_bucket)

Grafana dashboard with dedicated panels: taxonomy heatmap, error-rate by failure_reason, latency CDF by failure_reason, retry vs fallback outcomes, and top offender services; dashboard linked in ticket
Alert runbooks updated to reference taxonomy and recommended remediation (retry, fallback, capacity increase, model rollback)
End-to-end smoke test that injects synthetic failures and verifies tracehook tags and dashboard metrics appear within expected latency (<= 60s)
